g.text: The workflow begins on the left with the Initialization section.
Here, the Robot Model feeds into the central Robot block.
The Gripper Model provides the second input stream.
The Controller provides the third initialization input.
The middle section represents the Runtime phase.
At the center sits the main Robot unit.
From the bottom, Actions are directed upward into the Robot.
The Robot outputs Torques toward the top left.
It also emits Observations toward the top right.
The right section displays the Callables.
Specifications flow outward to the checklist icon.
Proprioception connects to the central human figure icon.
Finally, Sensors route data to the sensor icon at the bottom right.
